claim: The Shadow of War EULA prohibits modifying the game client (1c), reverse engineering or deriving source code (1d), cheats/hacks or unauthorized third-party programs (1e), and software that interacts with the client or emulates WB's protocols (1b), and allows connecting to WB game servers only with an unmodified authorized client (1g-1h); it has no mod-specific allowance.
evidence: EULA 1(d) wording includes 'reverse engineer, derive source code from'.
game_build_compatibility: Applies to the game generally; EULA text carries no date/version (PCGW reference dated 2018-07-17).
verification_method: Fetched and read the EULA page on 2026-10-23.
limitations: Not legal advice; enforceability of RE bans varies by jurisdiction (e.g. EU interoperability exceptions). Separate WB Terms of Service, incorporated by reference, were not reviewed.
next_experiment: Have the project owner obtain legal review; keep the mod strictly offline/non-commercial, never touch WB servers, never redistribute game files, and document interoperability purpose.
